label: Whatever begins or ceases to live between an earlier and a later time of the…, from immutability
meaning: Contrapositive of ST I q.10 a.1 under excluded middle: whatever is in potency in no respect has no beginning or end of life (STMT-IMMUTABLE-HAS-NO-LIFE-BOUNDARY, supported by the q.10 a.1 claim), so whatever begins or ceases to live is in potency in some respect. Derives STMT-LIFE-BOUNDARY-REQUIRES-POTENCY, which reaches the root without a derivation. This is a logical rearrangement: the gap the target carried (potency in the subject versus in another) now sits in the reading of 'omnino immutabile'. Both premises stay open.

strong_version_needed.ee4ab504-c8fe-59bc-bc96-7cbeefed6410: The proof applies excluded middle to propositions outside LocalLogic's scope, e.g. `∃ r, InPotency x r`. LocalLogic (ca432e24) decides only whether an actual bearer is identical with a GOD_4 candidate, and gives double-negation elimination for that candidate's esse–essence identity.
